banner.title: Analytics only with your consent
banner.body: Essential storage (session, language, settings) always works. With your consent we also collect anonymous usage statistics to improve the service.

settings.title: Privacy settings
settings.lead: Your choice is stored in this browser only. You can change it at any time.
settings.analyticsOff: Analytics isn’t switched on in the service yet: this consent applies once it is.

essential.label: Essential (always on)
essential.hint: Your session when signed in, the language, the seed for randomised exercises and your settings in the browser. The service doesn’t work without them.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.hint: Anonymous usage statistics (which pages and features are used), to improve the service.

embeds.label: YouTube and TikTok videos
embeds.hint: Players load straight away, without a click. YouTube and TikTok may then set their own cookies.
